inclusion_rule: Silent-speech, lip-reading and other non-acoustic speech or command decoders (any signal) whose ledger names few-shot, one-shot or N-shot learning, user-defined or customized vocabularies, vocabulary registration or personalized lip models; the design compared is how a user's new examples enter the model: a frozen pretrained encoder with a linear or logistic classifier, metric or prototype matching (Siamese, prototypical, triplet, nearest neighbour), fine-tuning network weights on the user, or user-dependent training from scratch. Boundary: a study counts under every design its full text (reference list removed) names, so counts are upper bounds; zero-shot speaker conditioning for synthesis, pruning 'one-shot' and BCI competitions are pattern hits that do not register a vocabulary; versions count once.
